Translations.Text: BART's schedule will change on Monday, August 10. Some train times are adjusting by several minutes. Use the BART Trip Planner with a date of August 10 or after to see if your trip has changed. bart.gov for details.

Next weekend, passengers traveling between Union City and Warm Springs must transfer to a free bus while crews make track upgrades. Expect delays of 30-40 minutes. Green Line service will not operate between Daly City and Berryessa on these work days. Visit bart.gov for more info.
